description: Experiment 1, v1: 2x2-5x2, random-search ordering, 5 trials, 2000 steps, bond_dim 64. See ../PLAN.md.
bond_dim_note: 2x2-5x2 production run at 64 without waiting for the pilots (queue). 64 is >= the exact cap for MC/enumerated at these sizes (4, 8, 32, 64), so those runs are exact. Purified (chain N+8) is checked afterwards with bond_dim_requirement on the production checkpoints; redo if it needs > 64.
bond_dim_needed_note: Smallest bond dim with discarded weight <= 1e-5, worst case over random init and 4 points along each of the 4 production runs (<lattice>/bond_dim_requirement.csv). Enumerated uses the trajectory value: its branches are the same circuits and its own measurement only partly finished before walltime.
